# compose-lint

> Lint docker-compose files with ten security and correctness rules, line numbers from the YAML node tree, bounded parsing and values never echoed Python package `trysac-compose-lint`, import name `compose_lint`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions, limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
